description.narrative: Persistent accelerates the growth of its partner companies through two keyways: • Investing human capital and leveraging its expertise through hands-on operating roles within management teams of investee companies, at board level, or as strategic advisers. The key support areas provided to entrepreneurs include financial & operational management, capital raising & structuring, business analytics & development of KPI tools, IT solutions. advisory, human capital advisory etc. • Early-stage financial capital to support the growth of the partner companies (founding capital, seed, or Series A). Persistent predominately invests in equity and convertible debt and provide bridge loans when needed.
Persistent investments include solar home systems and pay as you go technologies, commercial and industrial solar and mini-grids, e-mobility, productive use and ecosystem enablers

Persistent is an Africa-focused climate venture builder. It invests financial capital and human resources through its venture building model, from ideation stage through to early growth stage, working alongside entrepreneurs/ partners and supplying needed skills by seconding team members.
